_comment: Spec for scripts/deb-copyright.py: the .deb's DEP-5 copyright file and the
appends the SwiftPM notices from scripts/swiftpm-notices.py). Paths are
relative to this file; build-deb.sh sets the $VARS from the toolchain and
the vendored gtk4-layer-shell, and drops that component when it is not
vendored. ICU 76.1 is what Swift 6.3's swift-foundation-icu embeds;
scripts/static-runtime-notices.py fails the build when the binaries link

components.comment: Linked by --static-swift-stdlib. The Runtime Library Exception waives attribution; listed for completeness.

components.comment: Foundation's ICU code and icudt76l data (including the break-iterator dictionaries), whose third-party terms are part of the license text.

components.name: SwiftPM packages listed in Third-Party-Notices.txt
components.license_text: The packages pinned in linux/Package.resolved keep their own licenses: Apache-2.0, several with the Swift Runtime Library Exception. swift-crypto vendors BoringSSL, now also Apache-2.0; swift-nio vendors llhttp and cpp_magic.h under MIT. Their full license texts, NOTICE files and source revisions are in the SwiftPM section of Third-Party-Notices.txt.
copyright: The authors of each package, as listed in Third-Party-Notices.txt

components.name: gtk4-layer-shell
components.comment: A private copy, shipped because Ubuntu packages the GTK4 binding only from 25.10.
